actors.name: Fran
actors.private_context: Fran started the meal train for the Okafor family on the neighborhood app. Fran knows that eight slots were claimed the first evening, leaving six slots unfilled. Fran wants the remaining slots to be filled but has no specific plan beyond the sign-up being visible.

actors.name: Neighbors on Alder Court (60 households)
actors.private_context: Each household may or may not have seen the sign-up. Some may have already signed up; others may not yet have decided. They have varying degrees of familiarity with the Okafor family and Fran.

shared_context: A meal train sign-up for the Okafor family (newborn twins) was posted on the neighborhood app by Fran. The sign-up has 14 slots total. As of the start time, 8 slots have been claimed, leaving 6 slots open. The app allows any household to sign up for a slot. The cutoff for filling all slots is 2026-10-09T09:00:00-04:00.

starting_events.description: The meal train sign-up is active on the neighborhood app with 8 slots already claimed and 6 slots remaining.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that all 14 slots were claimed (i.e., signed up for) by 2026-10-09T09:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
